items.summary: Direct offers, flexible timelines and a free local move help simplify one of life’s biggest transactions. For many homeowners, selling through the traditional process can take close to three months from listing to closing. Across Offerpad markets, single-family homes are spending roughly 74 days on the market before going under contract , extending timelines for many sellers.
